contracts.source: 3M press release: 3M announces collaboration with GSEO to advance Expanded (10-19-2026)
contracts.signal: 3M announced (October 19, 2026) a collaboration with Genius Electronic Optical (GSEO, Taiwan: 3406) to advance technology development and manufacturing for its Expanded Beam Optical (EBO) solutions, selecting GSEO as a manufacturing partner: GSEO's precision optics manufacturing capabilities and technical development experience are expected to support manufacturing readiness for 3M's EBO ferrules, co-packaged optics solutions and related optical interconnect applications, and the companies aim to support EBO commercialization and long-term capacity expansion to meet growing demand from hyperscale data centers and other advanced connectivity applications. In support, 3M expects to make a strategic investment to acquire approximately 4.7% of GSEO's common shares in GSEO's private placement of newly issued shares, expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. CEO William Brown: selecting GSEO as a manufacturing partner and investing in it strengthens 3M's path to scale next-generation optical connectivity solutions for high-performance data center infrastructure. GSEO CEO and President Micro Kuo: GSEO is pleased to expand its relationship with 3M.
contracts.value: no specific figure (3M to acquire approximately 4.7% of GSEO's common shares)
contracts.type: manufacturing partnership and strategic equity investment
